about.name: Lucas Pazzim
about.tagline: Senior Frontend Engineer based in <0>São Paulo, Brazil</0>, building scalable, high-performance web applications with React, Next.js and TypeScript.
about.para1: I specialize in enterprise-grade interfaces aligned with frontend architecture, usability and business goals. My core expertise includes Web Performance, Technical SEO, Design Systems, Internationalization (i18n) and Accessibility (WCAG).
about.para2: I have strong experience optimizing Core Web Vitals, reducing bundle size, implementing code splitting and lazy loading, and designing scalable frontend architectures. I have led initiatives that significantly improved performance and organic indexing through metadata best practices, canonical strategies and optimized rendering approaches (SSR, SSG, ISR).
about.para3: I also bring solid experience in advanced component design, REST/GraphQL integrations, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (Jest, Vitest, Playwright) and monorepos, working closely with product, design and backend teams to deliver robust, scalable solutions.
